proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10286 mṛttikā gives Kumauni māṭo/māṭi and Nepali māṭo, eastern māṭi earth/clay. Dotyali məṭi retains the retroflex and final i with a central first vowel; this soil response belongs with the earth family. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: məṭi.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6261 *dādda explicitly gives Nepali dājyu elder brother. Dotyali dāju fits with loss of the palatal glide; the source length is preserved. This is a nursery kinship family. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: dāju.
